requirement_schemes.title: Integrated BBA Programme - Asian Business Studies Stream

parts.description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 58 units of courses as follows:

sections.title: Elective Courses
text: Students are required to study at one or two partner institution(s) of Asian Business Studies for one or two academic term(s) and complete 6 or 12 units of business-related courses with prior approval from the Faculty of Business Administration [b]. Academic results obtained from the partner institution(s) will not be included in the calculation of the Major GPA for honours classification. Under special circumstances, students who are unable to study at or complete the required number of units of courses at the partner institution(s) must make up the shortfall by completing appropriate courses at CUHK, subject to approval of Programme Director.

notes.text: ACCT/DOTE/FINA/IBBA/MGNT/MKTG courses at 2000 and above level (excluding ACCT2111, 2121, IBBA3040, MGNT2511 and 2512) will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.
Students are responsible for the extra costs incurred in relation to the resident study in the partner institution(s).
Students are not allowed to declare Management of International Business as their second concentration.
MKTG3010 and the associated units can be used to satisfy the major requirement and one of the second concentrations of the followings: Marketing, and Big Data and Quantitative Marketing.
Students claiming Entrepreneurship Concentration are not allowed to declare Minor in Entrepreneurship and Innovation.
ACCT2151 and 3151 are mutually exclusive. Students who would like to pursue a career in accounting profession are advised to take ACCT3151 instead of ACCT2151.

Students should complete 6 units of business-related courses with prior approval from the Faculty of Business Administration for each academic term during the resident study in the partner institution(s). Students must attend one and can attend up to two term-time overseas exchange programme(s) administrated by Asian Business Studies subject to approval of Programme Director.

requirement_schemes.title: Integrated BBA Programme - Global Business Studies Stream

parts.description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 65 units of courses as follows:

text: Students are required to study at two overseas institutions in Europe and North America through student exchange or study abroad programmes administered by the Faculty of Business Administration, Office of Academic Links or the Colleges for one academic term respectively, and complete 6 units of business-related courses in each institution approved by the Programme Director. Academic results obtained from the overseas institutions will not be included in the calculation of the Major GPA for honours classification. Under special circumstances, students who are unable to study at or complete the required number of units of courses at the overseas institutions must make up the shortfall by completing appropriate courses subject to the approval of Programme Director.

notes.text: ACCT/DOTE/FINA/IBBA/MGNT/MKTG courses at 2000 and above level (excluding ACCT2111, 2121, IBBA3040, MGNT2511 and 2512) will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

requirement_schemes.title: Integrated BBA Programme - International Business and Chinese Enterprise Stream

parts.description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 59 units of courses as follows:

text: Students are required to study at the University of South Carolina (USC) for one academic year and complete 6 units of designated thematic courses with prior approval from the Faculty of Business Administration before graduation. Units obtained from USC will be recognized as equivalent to up to 18 Major units. Academic results obtained from USC will not be included in the calculation of the Major GPA for honours classification. Under special circumstances, students who are unable to study at or complete the required number of units of courses at the partner institutions must make up the shortfall by completing appropriate courses at CUHK, subject to approval of Programme Director.

Students are not allowed to declare Minor in Business.
Students should have gone through a selection process in order to be admitted to this Double Major Programme.

Subject to approval by the Major Programmes concerned, students may opt out of the Double Major Programme and register for the 1st Major Programme only. The decision to opt out is irrevocable. Students who have opted out are required to complete and fulfill all graduation requirements by following the study scheme of the 1st Major Programme as a single major. Students should be aware that such decision may result in a delay in graduation because the requirements of the single major study scheme differ from those of the Double Major Programme.

text: JUPAS admittees without HKDSE Mathematics Extended Modules I or II are required to take ENGG1040 before they can take ENGG1125.

JUPAS admittees with the following HKDSE results do not need to take ENGG1040 and therefore will not be invited for the Mathematics Placement Test: - Level 5** in Mathematics Extended Module I; or - Level 5* or above in Mathematics Extended Module II.

Non-JUPAS admittees with the following public examination results do not need to take ENGG1040 and therefore will not be invited for the Mathematics Placement Test: - Grade 6 or above in IB Mathematics Analysis and Approaches (HL); or - Grade 7 in IB Mathematics Applications and Interpretation (HL); or - Grade A* in GCE-AL Further Mathematics

Other admittees except those specified above, are required to attend a Mathematics Placement Test. Students who fail or are absent from the Placement Test will be required to take ENGG1040 before they can take ENGG1125.

notes.text: If students decide to opt out of the Double Major Programme, they need to take DOTE1030 and DOTE1040 and MGNT2511 and MGNT2512 to fulfill the Faculty Package and Required Courses of Integrated BBA Programme respectively.
Students who fail ENGG1125 in Term 1 will have to retake the course in Term 2. The pre-assigned ENGG1130 in Term 2, will therefore be dropped.
Courses taken to fulfil the requirements of items 3(a) and (b)(i) and (ii) will be used to fulfill the requirement of General Business Concentration of the Integrated BBA Programme.
